judgment_calls.decision: "Sudden onset of" applied as a qualifier to every item of the anaphylaxis list, which is how the sentence reads.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Gold page 20 puts Sudden onset only on the skin group; that would let any cough/nausea after a bite make anaphylaxis probable.

judgment_calls.decision: Not a standalone disjunct: every patient on this page has a bite/sting, which footnote 3 counts as the exposure, so the rule is bite/sting AND any sudden-onset feature.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Treating exposure alone as sufficient would make every insect bite probable anaphylaxis; adding drug/food exposure disjuncts was not done.
